facts.fact: Adam几乎停住脚步——他意识到还有另一个人知道他杀了Ian。
facts.anchor: He almost stopped walking when he realized that there was someone else who knew he’d killed Ian.

facts.fact: Argent定下的下一步是先设法确认Night Market那具尸体的身份。
facts.anchor: “We will try to identify the body from the market.

facts.fact: 之后他们要看看Jack在查找Cole Lawrence收到的emails方面有没有进展。
facts.anchor: Then we will see if Jack has had any success in finding the emails Cole Lawrence received.”

facts.fact: Argent点破：他们曾警告Adam别调查与the Between有关的事，而他又一次身处其中。
facts.anchor: Because we warned you away from investigating matters related to the Between and yet here you are again, once more in the thick of it.”

facts.fact: Adam断定那具尸体是“空的”——就像Cole在音乐会上抓走的那些灵魂一样。
facts.anchor: “Empty,” Adam said. “It’s like the souls Cole snagged at the concert.

facts.fact: Adam从死者西装外套口袋里掏出一部手机。
facts.anchor: Adam reached into the man’s suit coat pocket and extracted a cell phone.

facts.fact: Carl从Adam的世界给女孩Lily带来了药，但Argent担心她活不下去了。
facts.anchor: “Carl has brought her medicine from your world, but I fear she will not survive.”

facts.fact: Vran曾为拯救学校和同学献出生命；这位精灵曾是Adam的朋友，情如弟弟。
facts.anchor: Vran had given his life to save the school and his classmates. The elf had been a friend, something like a little brother.
